component.name: Playlist Downloader
component.summary: YouTube and SoundCloud playlist downloader, MP3 or video

description.p: Playlist Downloader is a playlist downloader for Linux: a YouTube playlist downloader, a SoundCloud playlist downloader and a Bandcamp album downloader in one app. Search YouTube playlists by keyword, or paste a playlist link from YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Vimeo, Mixcloud, Dailymotion, Twitch and hundreds of other sites, pick the items you want and download the whole playlist as video or audio.

Playlist to MP3: convert a YouTube playlist to MP3, a SoundCloud set to MP3 or any playlist to M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV, with cover art and metadata embedded. Or keep the video: MP4, MKV or WebM up to 4K, with subtitles. Playlist Downloader is a music downloader, an album downloader and a 4K video downloader for whole playlists, channels and single tracks.

ul.li: Search YouTube playlists by keyword, with suggestions as you type; results show the cover, channel and video count
Paste a playlist link from YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Vimeo, Mixcloud, Dailymotion, Twitch and more, or a link to a single video or track
Browse the playlist before you download: every item with its thumbnail and length, select all, a range or a few, filter and sort
Download a whole playlist in one go: a batch download queue with pause, resume, retry and a folder per playlist, files numbered in playlist order
YouTube playlist to MP3, playlist to MP3, YouTube to MP3: audio only as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV, or video as MP4, MKV or WebM up to 4K, with subtitles, thumbnails and metadata embedded
A playlist file (M3U8) next to the downloaded files, so your music player plays the whole playlist offline in order
Skip items you already have, download YouTube channels, and download members-only and age-restricted items after signing in
A built-in browser with tabs, an ad blocker and a Download button on every page: find a playlist on any site and save it
The download engine sets itself up on first use and keeps itself updated; no command line

description.p: A native Qt app for the Linux desktop (Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch, openSUSE, Wayland and X11) with light and dark themes, a tray icon, taskbar progress and keyboard shortcuts. An alternative to 4K Video Downloader, 4K YouTube to MP3, JDownloader and online YouTube playlist to MP3 converters, with no ads and no watermarks.
